query:
SELECT ls.contaCustoId, cc.nome, ROUND(SUM(ls.valor), 2) as total, COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM lancamento_salario ls
JOIN conta_custo cc ON ls.contaCustoId = cc.id
WHERE ls.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY ls.contaCustoId, cc.nome
ORDER BY total DESC
